hypotheses.name: TF-module conditioned support calibration
hypotheses.method: Across immune/lung/external_lung with seeds 42/43/44, source/target-disjoint splits, and layers {7,11}, fit module-conditioned support weights (TF module membership + STRING density tier) on top of H70-style triangle-defect baseline with module-label permutation, matched-random-weight, and label-shuffle nulls.
hypotheses.next_action: If pursued once more, restrict to a depth-conditional layer-11 module model with pre-registered gate requiring >=2/6 positive null-gap domain-splits.

hypotheses.name: Pathway-centroid cross-model alignment
hypotheses.method: Seed42 pilot across immune/lung/external_lung and layers {7,11}; construct TRRUST+GO pathway centroids in scGPT and Geneformer spectral signature spaces and evaluate distance-rank concordance with module-label, module-membership, and signature-destroy nulls.
hypotheses.result_value: mean=+0.15032; mean CKA=0.21263; domain mean null-gap>0 in 0/3
hypotheses.next_action: Retire this endpoint for utility claims; only reopen with a materially different, pre-registered pathway-trajectory invariance objective.
hypotheses.retirement_reason: Repeated cross-model formulations remain null-gap negative despite endpoint redesign.

hypotheses.name: Neighbor-dropout detour elasticity v2
hypotheses.method: Seed42 screen across immune/lung/external_lung, source/target-disjoint splits, and layers {0,3,7,11}; remove top local-betweenness nodes at dropout rates {10%,20%,30%}, compare targeted vs matched-random detour inflation features against baseline with endpoint-swap, feature-shuffle, and label-shuffle nulls.
hypotheses.result_value: mean=-0.01199; positive rows=1/24; positive mean domain-splits=0/6; positive null-gap domain-splits=0/6
hypotheses.next_action: Retire this global-dropout utility formulation; if revisited, require edge-local witness-path perturbation with explicit path survival metrics.
hypotheses.retirement_reason: Major-change rescue still produced uniformly negative utility and null-gap outcomes.
